C0220.title: Chain Supermarket Colludes to Defraud E-Commerce Platform of Over 1.2 Million Yuan
C0220.summary: From April 2024 to March 2025, Yang, Dai, and other operators of Shanghai-based “H Supermarket,” together with franchise-store managers, organized offline staff to create fake e-commerce transactions through “order A, deliver B,” empty orders, and fabricated addresses. They defrauded platforms and brands of more than RMB 1.2 million in subsidies, and 21 suspects were placed under criminal coercive measures.
